scope: Public evidence-bound terminology for repository existence, internal software validation, prototype maturity, research maturity, standards references and certification boundaries.

V.label: Software-Validated
V.meaning: Repository-maintained executable checks passed for the stated software scope; this is internal software validation, not field proof or independent certification.

P.label: Verified Prototype
P.meaning: Implemented prototype with repository evidence and bounded internal checks; full software, operational or domain validation remains open.

R.label: Research
R.meaning: Repository-backed research implementation whose core scientific, experimental or product claim remains unresolved.

terminology.standards_referenced: A named standard, authoritative method or benchmark informs the work; conformity is not implied.
terminology.standards_aligned: Requires an explicit requirements/control mapping plus implementation and test evidence for the stated scope.
terminology.independently_certified: Requires a current certificate or assessment from an identified competent external body with a defined scope.

records.internal_evidence: Current v0.1.0 tree contains a repository-local unittest, compilation and invariant gate. The build records completion of internal validation; scientific and human-sensing validity remain unestablished.
records.standards_posture: Repository-local evidence and reproducibility protocol. No formal standards conformity or external certification is claimed.

records.internal_evidence: Current v0.4 tree contains deterministic pytest coverage and explicit reactor-loss qualification gates. A passing software gate is not experimental fusion, lunar-resource or net-power validation.
records.standards_posture: The NRL Plasma Formulary expression and provenance-qualified scientific sources are technical references, not energy-system certification.

records.internal_evidence: The v0.5 digital twin and unit-test gate support design calculations only. The repository explicitly records PTCG-1B as not experimentally validated.
records.standards_posture: BIPM frequency recommendations and NIST trapped-ion literature are metrology references; they do not certify the proposed device or causal-control hypothesis.

records.internal_evidence: The v0.2.0 release manifest records 25/25 tests passed plus compilation, CLI, bundle-integrity, synthetic-pipeline and external-fixture smoke gates.
records.standards_posture: NASA C-MAPSS is supported as an operator-supplied benchmark path. No ISO/IEC conformity, SIL certification or field-performance certification is claimed.

records.internal_evidence: The v0.1.0 tree contains repository-local pytest and Ruff gates for deterministic analysis, DSP, pipeline and QA behavior. No independent production-master validation is recorded.
records.standards_posture: No broadcast or mastering-standard conformity is claimed; integrated loudness, production limiting and true-peak validation remain open gates.

records.internal_evidence: The v0.1.0 validation record reports 8/8 tests passed for canonicalization, coordinate stability, propagation, attribution and rejection invariants.
records.standards_posture: SHA-256 and JSON-like canonicalization are implementation primitives. No formal standards conformity or external certification is claimed.

records.internal_evidence: The v0.1.0 verification record reports 10/10 tests passed, including deterministic evaluation and evidence-state invariants.
records.standards_posture: Evidence states and reproducibility rules are repository protocols. No forensic, legal, scientific or regulatory certification is claimed.
